purpose: 重賞かつ4歳以上のみのレースで、出走表スコアと併用して3頭BOX/表示軸を選ぶ。点数・購入見送り・自信度には使わない。

applies_to.grade_definition: pre-race: race name contains (BG1)/(BG2)/(BG3) OR matches grade_races.json name_keywords; also accepts race.grade if present
applies_to.age_rule: all non-scratched entries age>=4 (pure_O), same as card_score_age4

model_type: logistic regression for P(top3), L2 C=1.0, StandardScaler on train only

feature_definitions.last5_mean_norm_finish: mean of (finish-1)/(field_size-1) over up to 5 prior finished starts (date < race)
feature_definitions.last5_win_rate: wins / n among those last finished starts
feature_definitions.career_win_rate_before: career wins / prior starts (all statuses in prior window; win only if finish==1)
feature_definitions.last_start_finish: finish position of most recent prior finished start
feature_definitions.days_since_last: days between race date and last finished start
feature_definitions.prior_graded_count: count of prior starts (any age) with grade in {BG1,BG2,BG3}
feature_definitions.n_prior_starts: count of prior actual starts (any age) with date < race

imputation.note: If horse has zero finished priors in bundled history, use these defaults. prior_graded_count and n_prior_starts stay 0 when no priors.

combination_with_card_score_age4.definition: In graded pure_O races: z_card = within-race zscore of card-score utilities; z_g = within-race zscore of graded logit; combined = 0.5*z_card + 0.5*z_g. BOX = top 3 by combined (desc); display axis = top combined in BOX. Memrobo: force-include then rank by combined.
combination_with_card_score_age4.fallback: If graded features unavailable for all horses, use card_score_age4 BOX alone. Non-graded pure_O unchanged (card only).

training.rule: fit on all graded age>=4 finished starts with features and date<=history_through; predict only future race dates
